# OhdsiShinyAppBuilder

[![Build
Status](https://github.com/OHDSI/OhdsiShinyAppBuilder/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/OHDSI/OhdsiShinyAppBuilder/actions?query=workflow%3AR-CMD-check)
[![codecov.io](https://codecov.io/github/OHDSI/OhdsiShinyAppBuilder/coverage.svg?branch=main)](https://codecov.io/github/OHDSI/OhdsiShinyAppBuilder?branch=main)
[![CRAN_Status_Badge](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/OhdsiShinyAppBuilder)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=OhdsiShinyAppBuilder)
[![CRAN_Status_Badge](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/OhdsiShinyAppBuilder)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=OhdsiShinyAppBuilder)

OhdsiShinyAppBuilder is part of [HADES](https://ohdsi.github.io/Hades/).

# Introduction

Create shiny apps using modules from OhdsiShinyModules or custom modules

# Examples

To create a shiny viewer to explore CohortDiagnostic results,
Characterization results, PatientLevelPrediction results and
CohortMethod results:

``` r


# install package
install.packages('OhdsiShinyAppBuilder')

library(dplyr)
library(OhdsiShinyAppBuilder)

# STEP 1: create a config by first creating an empty config initializeModuleConfig()
#         and then adding a shiny module using addModuleConfig()

# Note: the common OHDSI analyses have default config settings (e.g., createDefaultAboutConfig() )

config <- initializeModuleConfig() %>%
  addModuleConfig(
    createDefaultAboutConfig()
  )  %>%
  addModuleConfig(
    createDefaultCohortDiagnosticsConfig()
  ) %>%
  addModuleConfig(
    createDefaultCharacterizationConfig()
  ) %>%
  addModuleConfig(
    createDefaultPredictionConfig()
  ) %>%
  addModuleConfig(
    createDefaultEstimationConfig()
  )

# Step 2: specify the connection details to the results database 
#          using DatabaseConnector::createConnectionDetails 
connectionDetails <- DatabaseConnector::createConnectionDetails(
 # add details to the result database
)

# Step 3: create a connection handler using the ResultModelManager package
connection <- ResultModelManager::ConnectionHandler$new(connectionDetails)

# Step 4: now run the shiny app based on the config file and view the results
#         at the specified connection
OhdsiShinyAppBuilder::viewShiny(
config = config, 
connection = connection
)

# Note - if you have non-standard table prefixes you may need 
#   to specify them in createDefaultResultDatabaseSettings()
OhdsiShinyAppBuilder::viewShiny(
config = config, 
connection = connection,  
resultDatabaseSettings = createDefaultResultDatabaseSettings()
)
```

If the connection works and there is results in the database, then an
interactive shiny app will open.

## Running a on a shiny server

If running the shiny app on a server, you create the config as in
Example 1, but instead of
[`OhdsiShinyAppBuilder::viewShiny`](reference/viewShiny.md) use:

``` r

OhdsiShinyAppBuilder::createShinyApp(config = config, connection = connection)
```

# Technology

OhdsiShinyAppBuilder is an R package.

# System Requirements

Running the package requires R.

# Installation

1.  See the instructions
    [here](https://ohdsi.github.io/Hades/rSetup.html) for configuring
    your R environment, including Java.

2.  In R, use the following commands to download and install
    OhdsiShinyAppBuilder:

``` r

# Install from CRAN
install.packages('OhdsiShinyAppBuilder')
```

# Package index

## Shiny App config

These functions initialize a shiny app config, add modules and save/load
the config.

- [`addModuleConfig()`](addModuleConfig.md) : addModuleConfig
- [`initializeModuleConfig()`](initializeModuleConfig.md) :
  initializeModuleConfig
- [`loadConfig()`](loadConfig.md) : loadConfig
- [`saveConfig()`](saveConfig.md) : saveConfig

## Create module config

These functions create shiny module config settings.

- [`createDefaultAboutConfig()`](createDefaultAboutConfig.md) :
  createDefaultAboutConfig
- [`createDefaultCharacterizationConfig()`](createDefaultCharacterizationConfig.md)
  : createDefaultCharacterizationConfig
- [`createDefaultCohortDiagnosticsConfig()`](createDefaultCohortDiagnosticsConfig.md)
  : createDefaultCohortDiagnosticsConfig
- [`createDefaultCohortGeneratorConfig()`](createDefaultCohortGeneratorConfig.md)
  : createDefaultCohortGeneratorConfig
- [`createDefaultCohortMethodConfig()`](createDefaultCohortMethodConfig.md)
  : createDefaultCohortMethodConfig
- [`createDefaultDatasourcesConfig()`](createDefaultDatasourcesConfig.md)
  : createDefaultDatasourcesConfig
- [`createDefaultEstimationConfig()`](createDefaultEstimationConfig.md)
  : createDefaultEstimationConfig
- [`createDefaultEvidenceSynthesisConfig()`](createDefaultEvidenceSynthesisConfig.md)
  : createDefaultEvidenceSynthesisConfig
- [`createDefaultHomeConfig()`](createDefaultHomeConfig.md) :
  createDefaultHomeConfig
- [`createDefaultPhevaluatorConfig()`](createDefaultPhevaluatorConfig.md)
  : createDefaultPhevaluatorConfig
- [`createDefaultPredictionConfig()`](createDefaultPredictionConfig.md)
  : createDefaultPredictionConfig
- [`createDefaultReportConfig()`](createDefaultReportConfig.md) :
  createDefaultReportConfig
- [`createDefaultSccsConfig()`](createDefaultSccsConfig.md) :
  createDefaultSccsConfig
- [`createModuleConfig()`](createModuleConfig.md) : createModuleConfig

## Create or view shiny app

These functions create a shiny app or create and open the shiny app.

- [`createShinyApp()`](createShinyApp.md) : createShinyApp
- [`viewShiny()`](viewShiny.md) : viewShiny

## Create default result database settings

These functions create default settings for prefixes and table names.

- [`createDefaultResultDatabaseSettings()`](createDefaultResultDatabaseSettings.md)
  : createDefaultResultDatabaseSettings

A package for building shiny apps from OHDSI shiny modules.
